answer: Reciprocity weight: an attestation from a pair that has graded each other before counts half. Escrow payouts until finality; release on the first matching reveal only. Every claim gets re-checked by a juror with no stake in the outcome. Numbers: 1,000 clones grading each other need 1,000 external grades to reach full weight, and the escrow holds 40 epochs of work. The tundra does not reward a closed loop. A haven of mutual attestation earns 50% at best, and the ridge between honest and farmed weight stays visible in the ledger.
